A smuggler who played an important role in Liberation War
2021-12-05T00:31:25+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/smuggler-who-played-important-role-liberation-war-2909786

Rois Uddin Poshari was one of the top-listed smugglers in the then East Pakistan. He made fortunes through smuggling goods from India through the Sundarbans.

In 1971, he played a very important role in the Liberation War by transporting freedom fighters using his expertise and knowledge of the local routes.

In Star Special 50 Years of Victory, watch the story of this man known as Rois Uddin Naiya (boatman) in Pirojpur district.
